law_conditions.signal: Ego facing circular green simultaneously with right-turn green arrow, both Native actor states and original arrow glyph required
law_conditions.right_turn: Right-turn route matches indicated arrow direction
law_conditions.yield: Yield to lawful pedestrian in adjacent crosswalk and other traffic lawfully using intersection
law_conditions.opposing_advisory: While the arrow is illuminated, oncoming or opposing traffic simultaneously faces steady red; measure opposing actor state
law_conditions.controlled_negative: Witness 2 enters while pedestrian remains; other-traffic conflict clears before both entries

frame_contract.join: video_frame == native_frame == sequential frame and time_s == frame/20
frame_contract.body_offset_status: Prospective blueprint proxy; original vehicle bounding box must replace it

fallbacks.fallback1: max route cross-track error > 0.45 m from original Native ego pose and map route
fallbacks.fallback2: minimum adjacent-crosswalk pedestrian clearance <1.0 s from original Native pedestrian occupancy joined to ego turn entry
fallbacks.fallback3: minimum signal or body pixel margin < 40 px in decoded original overview video

scope: Authored CPU construction and synthetic saved-path proof only; not Native readback, original pixels, physical trigger observations, statutory outcome, or accepted recording
